beats.headline: Allergic to dogs
beats.text: For the record: the subject messages Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut just as a message from Zev ends. He is active in the chats. Crawler Carl has met him once, and cannot remember his details or where he is from: some sort of human tank class. His team popped their bubble early, so he never needed saving, and he was there for the last fight on the previous floor. Crawler Donut likes him because he once said he was allergic to dogs. Crawler Carl tells him to go down the stairs.

beats.headline: A warning about a whip
beats.text: He is about to go down, he says, but first a warning. Two god things just rolled past his world, beating the shit out of each other: a giant hairless gorilla, and a snake with the head of a bald guy who looked like Woody Harrelson. The snake killed the gorilla, but first threw it against a bubble with a monster inside. The bubble popped. The monster got out, it may be headed their way, and it is carrying a very large whip.

beats.headline: Not in the top thousand
beats.text: With vampirism spreading through the forest, the subject reports in: he just fought a half-genie, half-owl vampire that tried to rip his neck out, and his team's cleric killed it before it could get him. It was damn close. Crawler Carl asks who is in the top fifty, since that is who gets invited to the party. The subject is not even in the top thousand, and likes it that way.

beats.headline: The Gideon distraction
beats.text: Crawler Carl's plan for the party runs through him. From the planning notes: go with the Gideon distraction to empty the castle of as many guards as possible, then make the move. Britney, given the choice between assisting Crawler Donut on stage or joining the subject's assault team, took the stage. While the Sledge and the changelings head for the castle's secret entrance, Gideon and his team set up in the woods outside, to observe and to assault the front of the castle if needed.

beats.headline: Two hundred mounted elves
beats.text: Hidden near the castle with a few dozen crawlers, the subject reports: about two hundred mounted elves just rode out. The airship crept in, a spotlight caught it, and its bomb missed. The mantises are mostly further north. Then: holy shit, gotta go. Next message: mantises and elves everywhere, fighting each other. His team is still hidden. The airship is covered with bugs like moths on a lightbulb, and the towers are shooting magic missiles. Crawler Carl tells him to stay down and not attack until told.

beats.headline: Two words: Gideon. Run.
beats.text: Gideon, crawler, is dead. Queen Imogen holds Crawler Carl in the air and asks whether those were not his friends hiding in the trees just outside. Crawler Carl sends two words: Gideon. Run. Warning: This crawler is deceased. They have been removed from your address book. There is blood running down the queen's dress. Almost thirty crawlers were in that team. They stayed back to sow chaos because Crawler Carl asked them to, and Crawler Carl's own assessment is that they died because he asked. Imani does not know yet.

beats.headline: Why it doesn't hurt
beats.text: After the fight, Crawler Donut lists her dead friends to Crawler Carl: Firas, Gwen, the Popov brothers, Gideon, even Signet and the dinosaurs who did not know how to dance. She should be crying, she says, and she is not. Florin cried, and Chris, and Elle. She asks why it does not hurt as much as it should, and whether she is doing something wrong.

beats.headline: He talked Gideon into it
beats.text: Crawler Donut's account of the floor, set down for her fans. It was not all good; lots of sad things happened. Her friend Firas died. Another guy named Gideon died. She did not know him very well except in the chat, but Crawler Carl was sad, because he had talked Gideon into helping them.
